home.faq.licensed.a: Yes — every practitioner holds a current Thai Ministry of Public Health licence () and is recertified annually.
home.faq.equipment.a: Yes. Therapists arrive with portable table, fresh linens, oils, and amenities.
home.faq.hotels.a: Most central Bangkok hotels including Mandarin Oriental, Anantara, Park Hyatt, St. Regis, and serviced residences.
home.faq.payments.a: Pay in-app with card, WeChat Pay, AliPay, PromptPay, or cash on arrival. No tipping required.
home.faq.languages.a: English, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, and ไทย — both in-app and via 24/7 multilingual concierge.

pay.faq.cost.q: What is the cost of a session?
pay.faq.cost.a: Each practitioner sets their own rates — the exact starting price is shown on their profile. The total reflects the service fee plus a transparent travel fee, aligned with GrabCar pricing (฿45 base, tiered per kilometre, return at half rate).
pay.faq.deposit.a: For long-distance reservations — beyond approximately 25 km from central Sukhumvit — we request a modest deposit to secure the practitioner's travel commitment. This is communicated in advance, never as a surprise.
pay.faq.cancel.a: Complimentary cancellation or rescheduling up to 30 minutes before the appointment. Beyond that window — or once the practitioner is en route — a 50% service-fee charge applies, in respect of their committed time and travel.
pay.faq.secure.a: Yes. We use plain-card statements (no service description), tokenised processing for online methods, and never store your card numbers ourselves. Your reservation, your privacy.
